name: West Plains (United States)
description: Blue field with a yellow cross, charged at the centre with a yellow ring enclosing a square lozenge formed by the arms of the cross, after the downtown court square.
history: West Plains is a city in and the county seat of Howell County, Missouri. The flag was adopted on 20 May 2019 (the design by Isaac Protiva, chosen from 140 submissions in an open competition, was formally adopted by the city council on 20 May 2019, according to Flags of the World citing Ozark Radio News).
